plugins.name: context-nudge
plugins.description: Keeps a terse session ledger and offers a clean restart (/clear, then /context-restart) when a session gets heavy. Skills only; never clears or compacts on its own.

plugins.name: context-nudge-hook
plugins.description: Optional add-on for context-nudge: a UserPromptSubmit hook that measures context size and triggers the nudge automatically. Requires Node.js 18+.
